S.sql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN (typeof(version)='integer' AND version BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __valid,
  CASE WHEN (typeof(version)='integer' AND version BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991) THEN version ELSE NULL END AS version
FROM schema_migrations
WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY version
LIMIT 20;

Z.sql:
WITH witness(ordinal,table_name,present) AS (VALUES
(0,'preferences',CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM preferences WHERE workspace_id=? LIMIT 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
(1,'outbox',CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outbox WHERE workspace_id=? LIMIT 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
(2,'catalog_plans',CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM catalog_plans WHERE workspace_id=? LIMIT 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
(3,'import_plans',CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM import_plans WHERE workspace_id=? LIMIT 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
(4,'decision_checkpoints',CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decision_checkpoints WHERE workspace_id=? LIMIT 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
(5,'decision_proposals',CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decision_proposals WHERE workspace_id=? LIMIT 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
(6,'approvals',CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM approvals WHERE workspace_id=? LIMIT 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
(7,'decision_artifact_edges',CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decision_artifact_edges WHERE workspace_id=? LIMIT 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
(8,'decision_lifecycle_heads',CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decision_lifecycle_heads WHERE workspace_id=? LIMIT 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
(9,'decision_lifecycle_transitions',CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decision_lifecycle_transitions WHERE workspace_id=? LIMIT 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
(10,'decision_notice_intents',CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decision_notice_intents WHERE workspace_id=? LIMIT 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
) SELECT table_name,present FROM witness ORDER BY ordinal LIMIT 11;
Z.note: Exact eleven fixed labels; all present=0. Includes all seven inactive decision tables; no decision operation or grant.
